proof:
classical
intro N inst C0 C1 bases
unfold M7.OrbitResidual.remaining
apply Finset.ext
intro x
simp only [Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_union]
constructor
· rintro ⟨h0 | h1, h⟩
  · exact Or.inl ⟨h0, h⟩
  · exact Or.inr ⟨h1, h⟩
· rintro (⟨h0, h⟩ | ⟨h1, h⟩)
  · exact ⟨Or.inl h0, h⟩
  · exact ⟨Or.inr h1, h⟩
